dish.title: Ginger Scallion Fish Packets
dish.name: Ginger Scallion Fish Packets
dish.description: Foil packets of white fish and halved bok choy with ginger, scallion, and soy, baked until the fish flakes, served with rice.

recipe.provenance_note: Legacy menu text of unknown origin. This draft reconciles that text. It does not claim a kitchen test.

recipe_version.title: Ginger Scallion Fish Packets
recipe_version.description: Foil packets of white fish and halved bok choy with ginger, scallion, and soy, baked until the fish flakes, served with rice.
recipe_version.serving_basis_note: Quantities are for 4 servings. One- and two-serving floors are not in this draft.
recipe_version.heat: Oven 400 F for the packets. Rice simmers, covered, on the stove and overlaps the bake.
recipe_version.doneness: Fish flakes easily and is opaque in the center, 18 to 20 minutes at 400 F. Bok choy is tender. Rice is tender and the water is absorbed. Not a rare fillet and not a sear.

ingredients.name: long-grain white rice
ingredients.note: Dry. v1 said serve with rice and did not list it. Drafter amount for 4 servings.

ingredients.name: water for packets
ingredients.note: The v1 splash, which was not an ingredient. About 1/2 tbsp in each packet. Drafter amount.

ingredients.name: white fish fillets
ingredients.note: About 6 oz each, 1.5 lb total. Drafter weight. v1 said only 4. Not locked to cod. v1 primary_ingredient was cod, but the ingredient line is white fish.

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.note: Regular soy sauce. Wheat and soy. Not tamari and not a gluten-free substitute.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Rinse the rice. Combine it with the 3 cups water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 18 minutes, until the rice is tender and the water is absorbed. Rest covered, off heat, while the packets are opened. Do not salt the rice. Start this when the packets go into the oven. Do not add the 18 minutes on top of the bake.

steps.title: Pack the packets
steps.body: Heat the oven to 400 F. On each of 4 foil sheets, put 1 fish fillet and half a head of bok choy. Divide the ginger, scallions, soy sauce, and the 2 tbsp packet water across the four packets. Seal the foil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 400 F for 18 to 20 minutes, until the fish flakes easily and is opaque in the center and the bok choy is tender.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Open the foil carefully. Serve each packet with the rice. Do not add a sauce that was not in the packet.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Dairy-free only. No milk, butter, cheese, or cream. Not plant and not vegetarian, because of the fish. Not gluten-free, because the soy sauce is wheat. fish and finfish are not dietary labels.
allergen_notes: Finfish from the white fish. Soy and wheat from regular soy sauce.
Rice, ginger, scallion, bok choy, and water add none of egg, milk, sesame, peanut, tree_nut, or shellfish.
Do not swap in tamari or gluten-free soy sauce. That would be a different recipe.

dietary_eligibility.hh001_reason: Finfish. Not an HH001 plant meal.
